LanguageData.RimMT_SettingsIntro: Compatibility-first optimizations. Risky simulation threading stays disabled unless explicitly implemented and validated.
LanguageData.RimMT_TextCacheDesc: Caches repeated UI text size/height calculations. Low risk; automatically disabled if another mod patches the same methods.
LanguageData.RimMT_OverlayCacheDesc: Avoids scanning every overlay-capable Thing every rendered frame while the camera is stationary. Draw calls remain on the main thread.
LanguageData.RimMT_ReachNoCacheDesc: Experimental and OFF by default. Reuses only recent false reachability results for cell targets. Can delay recognition of a newly opened route by a few ticks.
